mapper.select: select (select count(1) from wm_batch b and b.farmer_id = #{farmerId}) as batchCount, (select count(1) from wm_farm_record r left join wm_batch b on b.batch_id = r.batch_id and b.farmer_id = #{farmerId}) as farmCount, (select ifnull(sum(b.scan_count), 0) from wm_batch b and b.farmer_id = #{farmerId}) as scanCount, count(q.qc_id) as qcCount, round(ifnull(avg(q.sugar_center), 0), 2) as avgSugar, ifnull(max(q.sugar_center), 0) as maxSugar, ifnull(min(q.sugar_center), 0) as minSugar, round(ifnull(avg(q.weight_kg), 0), 2) as avgWeight, ifnull(sum(case when q.grade_code in ('SPECIAL', 'FIRST') then 1 else 0 end), 0) as premiumCount from wm_qc_record q left join wm_batch b on b.batch_id = q.batch_id

select ifnull(nullif(q.grade_code, ''), 'NONE') as gradeCode, ifnull(nullif(max(q.grade_name), ''), '等外') as gradeName, count(1) as total from wm_qc_record q left join wm_batch b on b.batch_id = q.batch_id
group by ifnull(nullif(q.grade_code, ''), 'NONE') order by total desc

select floor(q.sugar_center) as bucket, count(1) as total from wm_qc_record q left join wm_batch b on b.batch_id = q.batch_id
group by floor(q.sugar_center) order by bucket

select date_format(q.check_time, '%Y-%m') as month, count(1) as total, round(avg(q.sugar_center), 2) as avgSugar, round(avg(q.sugar_edge), 2) as avgEdge from wm_qc_record q left join wm_batch b on b.batch_id = q.batch_id
group by date_format(q.check_time, '%Y-%m') order by month

select ifnull(nullif(b.variety, ''), '未知') as variety, count(1) as total, round(avg(q.sugar_center), 2) as avgSugar, round(avg(q.weight_kg), 2) as avgWeight from wm_qc_record q left join wm_batch b on b.batch_id = q.batch_id
group by ifnull(nullif(b.variety, ''), '未知') order by total desc

select b.batch_id as batchId, b.batch_code as batchCode, b.variety as variety, count(q.qc_id) as total, round(avg(q.sugar_center), 2) as avgSugar, round(avg(q.weight_kg), 2) as avgWeight, sum(case when q.grade_code in ('SPECIAL', 'FIRST') then 1 else 0 end) as premiumCount from wm_qc_record q left join wm_batch b on b.batch_id = q.batch_id
group by b.batch_id, b.batch_code, b.variety order by b.batch_id desc
